title: Top Earbuds: AirPods Pro 3 & Rivals (2026)
summary: Tom's Guide picks the AirPods Pro 3 as the best wireless earbuds, while TechRadar and SoundGuys back the Sony WF-1000XM6 and Technics EAH-AZ100 for Android, the Bose QC Ultra for noise cancelling and the Cambridge Melomania A100 for value.
method: Picks come from Tom's Guide (updated Sep 22, 2026), TechRadar's wireless earbuds guide (Jun 18, 2026) and SoundGuys' lab-tested guide (Jun 2, 2026). Each product here is named by at least two of the three.
assumptions: Prices are what Tom's Guide's price box showed on the day we checked and change often, so check the current price on Amazon. Tom's Guide ratings are from its own testing; TechRadar and SoundGuys use different test methods.

products.name: Apple AirPods Pro 3
why: Tom's Guide's top pick, and SoundGuys' best for iPhone. Noise cancelling is much improved, the transparency mode is excellent, and the new foam-infused tips and XXS size make them comfortable for long wear.
Battery is 8 hours with ANC (10 in transparency mode). Tom's Guide says Android users lose out because there is no app and limited codec support.
specs: Up to 8 hours per charge, 24 hours with the case
IP57 sweat and water resistance
Heart rate sensing and Live Translation (needs a compatible iPhone)
No charging cable in the box
cons: Live Translation needs an iPhone with Apple Intelligence
products.best_for: iPhone owners who want the best all-rounder
products.amazon_listing: Apple AirPods Pro 3 Wireless Earbuds with Active Noise Cancellation | Live Translation, He

products.name: Sony WF-1000XM6
why: Tom's Guide's best alternative to the AirPods and SoundGuys' best wireless earbuds overall. Sound is well balanced and crisp, with LDAC support, DSEE Extreme upscaling, and a user-friendly Sound Connect app with fit and EQ tests.
Tom's Guide found ANC excellent and a big step up, though Bose still beats it for pure noise blocking. The new case is awkward in pockets and the price went up from the XM5.
specs: 8 hours with ANC, 24 hours with the case
LDAC codec support
Personalized EQ and fit test in the Sound Connect app
Three colors
cons: Price hike from the previous model
products.best_for: Android users and anyone who wants top sound plus strong ANC
products.skip_if: You want the very best noise blocking, or are tight on budget
products.amazon_listing: Sony WF-1000XM6 The Best Noise Cancelling Wireless Earbuds, Black | Truly Wireless Headpho

products.name: Technics EAH-AZ100
why: TechRadar's pick for the best wireless earbuds overall in 2026. It praises the full, detailed sound and an incredibly comfortable fit, and SoundGuys names it the best earbuds for Android.

They are Technics' smallest and lightest flagship earbuds yet, with several tip sizes in the box. Connectivity includes LDAC hi-res audio and LC3 Bluetooth LE Audio. TechRadar says the Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds block noise slightly better.
specs: LDAC hi-res support
LC3 Bluetooth LE Audio support
Smallest and lightest Technics flagship earbuds so far
cons: Noise cancelling is a bit behind the Bose
products.best_for: Android users who care about sound and comfort
products.skip_if: Noise cancelling is your number one need
products.amazon_listing: Technics EAH-AZ100 True Wireless Earbuds With Dolby Atmos

products.name: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen)
why: Tom's Guide's best for noise cancelling and TechRadar ranks them at #4 but says they cancel noise a bit better than its top pick. Tom's Guide calls the ANC the best around, with improved sound and call quality over the first model and no price increase.
Battery is the weak spot at 6 hours, and you can't turn ANC off to stretch it. Tom's Guide adds that the EQ in the Bose app is worth adjusting.
specs: 6 hours per charge, 24 hours with the case
Wireless charging
Immersive Audio spatial mode (cuts battery by about 2 hours)
Comes with several tips and fins
products.best_for: Commuters and frequent flyers who want maximum quiet
products.amazon_listing: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen) - Wireless Noise Cancelling Earbuds with Mic, Im

products.name: Cambridge Audio Melomania A100
why: Tom's Guide's best-value pick and TechRadar's best mid-range pick. Tom's Guide says the sound beats anything at the price, with punchy bass and a wider soundstage, and it is very comfortable.
Battery is the standout at 10 hours per charge and 39 hours with the case. The ANC is decent but bettered by Sony and Bose, and the touch controls are very simple.
specs: 10 hours per charge, 39 hours with the case
ANC, transparency mode and a useful EQ
Compact charging case
LDAC support (lowers battery life a bit)
products.best_for: Anyone who wants great sound and battery for about $100-$150
products.amazon_listing: Cambridge Audio Melomania A100 Earbuds - in Ear True Wireless Headphones with Adaptive Act

products.name: Beats Powerbeats Pro 2
why: Named the best for fitness by Tom's Guide and the best for working out by SoundGuys. Tom's Guide's fitness expert says the earhooks keep them in place during runs and other workouts.

They have a built-in heart rate monitor (Tom's Guide found it a little inaccurate) and ANC similar to the AirPods Pro 2. They work best with iPhones, and on Android the Beats app had some heart rate quirks.
specs: 10 hours per charge, 45 hours with the case
Earhook design with built-in heart rate monitor
Active noise cancelling, head-tracked spatial audio (Apple Music)
cons: Some dip in the upper mids
products.best_for: Runners and gym-goers who need earbuds that stay put
products.skip_if: You want the best sound or a compact case
products.amazon_listing: Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 - Wireless Noise Cancelling Workout Earbuds with Secure- Fit Earhoo
